tools.name: split_rent
tools.description: Split a fixed monthly rent across rooms, equally or weighted by room size, and divide a shared room's rent equally between its occupants. Use when deciding who pays how much rent. Do NOT use for utility bills (use split_utilities) or to settle who already paid what (use settle_up).

tools.name: split_utilities
tools.description: Split utility and household bills across housemates, each bill equally, by occupants, or by usage weight, and total what each person owes. Use for recurring shared bills such as electricity, gas or internet. Do NOT use for rent (use split_rent) or to settle who already paid (use settle_up).

tools.name: settle_up
tools.description: Split shared costs equally between housemates, compare with what each already paid, and compute balances plus the fewest payments that settle everyone. Use after people fronted money for the group. Computes only; moves no money. Do NOT use for usage-weighted bills (use split_utilities).

tools.name: roommate_agreement
tools.description: Draft a plain-language shared-living agreement (parties, term, equal rent shares, deposit, utilities, house rules, notice, signature lines) plus a pre-signing checklist. Use when housemates want house terms in writing. Not legal advice. Do NOT use to compute unequal rent (use split_rent) or bill sha

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "split_rent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
